name: switch__ccu_echo_via_engine
description: Same regression guard as switch__ccu_echo but the trigger routes through the production dirty-mark → subscription engine → reportSubscription path. Exercises the full ship pipeline, not just the wire-shape boundary. Without F4 the engine still ships a report but on the peer-opened Subscribe exchange — the harness catches that as Initiator=false and ExchangeID=PeerSubscribeExchangeID.
